description: Test suite for compliance export commands in Mattermost's mmctl CLI, including listing, showing, canceling, and downloading compliance export jobs, with focus on permissions, job creation, and job start time logic.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for end-to-end testing of compliance export commands.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportListCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests listing compliance export jobs, permissions, pagination, and job creation/deletion.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportShowCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests showing details of a specific compliance export job, including permissions and non-existent jobs.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportCancelCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests canceling compliance export jobs, permissions, job states, and error handling.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportDownloadCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests downloading compliance export files, permissions, file existence, and zip content verification.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportMmctlJobStartTimeE2E
methods.description: Verifies that mmctl jobs use batch_start_time from previous regular jobs and handle multiple mmctl jobs correctly.
